# Python dependencies used by helper scripts in this repository.
#
# Install with:
#   python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Important:
# - This file does NOT cover the full C++ / ROS / CUDA runtime.
# - For the full environment, also see:

# Used by pt_to_onnx.py to export a trained YOLO .pt model to ONNX.
ultralytics>=8.3,<9
onnx>=1.16,<2

# Optional Python-side ONNX Runtime.
# The main C++ project uses its own vendored ONNX Runtime instead.
# Uncomment one of the following if you need Python inference tooling:
# onnxruntime>=1.16,<2
# onnxruntime-gpu>=1.16,<2
